def es_palindromo(texto: str) -> bool:
    # Filtrar caracteres alfanuméricos y a.lower()
    filtered = [c.lower() for c in texto if c.isalnum()]
    # Comprobar si la secuencia es palíndroma
    return filtered == filtered[::-1]

import re
from typing import List, Tuple

def palabras_frecuentes(texto: str, n: int) -> List[Tuple[str, int]]:
    if n <= 0 or not texto:
        return []
    
    # Find all sequences of letters and digits
    words = re.findall(r'[A-Za-z0-9]+', texto)
    # Convert to lowercase
    words = [word.lower() for word in words]
    
    # Count frequencies
    freq = {}
    for word in words:
        freq[word] = freq.get(word, 0) + 1
    
    # Sort by frequency descending, then by word ascending
    sorted_words = sorted(freq.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))
    
    # Take top n (or all if n > len)
    result = [(word, count) for word, count in sorted_words[:n]]
    
    return result
